info.description: HTTP API for managing Machinarchy environments, SSH hosts, and job history.
info.title: Machinarchy API

post.description: Authenticates an account, returns a JWT, and sets the auth_token cookie.
Creates an account, returns a JWT, and sets the auth_token cookie.
Registers a host after validating SSH connectivity and the expected host-key fingerprint. SecretData contains the SSH password or private key and is never returned.

parameters.description: Host connection details; provide either ip or hostname. SecretData is the SSH password or private key and is never returned.
parameters.name: request

put.description: Updates host metadata and credentials. SecretData contains the SSH password or private key and is never returned.

BearerAuth.description: Supply a JWT as `Bearer <token>`. The API also accepts the auth_token cookie.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
